description: Demo fixture for the Monthly Revision page. Production should replace this with Kanso/sales/delivery actuals, user context and live monthly context feeds without changing the revision surface.

channel_performance.context: Reach delivery broadly on plan but late-month response softened.
London panels underdelivered against booked impression proxy.
Door drops and lapsed segments beat forecast.
Video test delivery under target; keep as capped test.
Search captured demand efficiently but query volume remains capped.
Prospecting weaker than retargeting; needs split before production.

user_context: Planner note: June was weaker than expected after school term and travel disruption affected local response.
Client note: protect April/December style tentpole logic, but avoid scaling weak June digital tests without measurement.

monthly_context.weather: Warmer, drier summer weeks; outdoor attention improves but response attribution is weak.
monthly_context.sports: Football creative context continues, but no automatic budget movement without performance proof.
monthly_context.calendar: Summer holidays begin; review family/charity messaging and local salience.

revision_rules: Freeze months before the selected revision month.
Use the approved annual plan as the baseline.
Reallocate the selected and remaining months only.
Prior-month underperformance reduces weak-evidence test channels unless user context explicitly protects them.
Direct Mail and Paid Search can receive modest uplift when prior-month sales index is strong, subject to saturation/cap warnings.
Revision output is a new plan version candidate requiring human approval.

channel_performance.context: AV demand generation running ahead of target.
Mail response strong ahead of winter draw.

user_context: Planner note: protect December draw support and avoid stripping AV too aggressively.
Client note: approvals must preserve brand safety and charitable/community positioning.

monthly_context.weather: Colder, wetter evenings likely increase home media consumption.
monthly_context.sports: Winter sport context supports AV/audio adjacency checks.
monthly_context.calendar: Christmas and December draw preparation; higher attention and higher clutter.
